name: Travel
operation_language: Authoring declarations only; not registered engine opcodes.

authored_operations.requirement: Represent five-mile stages, pace and terrain ceilings, good roads, slow travelers, special movement and mount fast-travel budgets; use the complete pace/rate/check tables. Bind marching order, encounter distance, navigation, foraging and search to each stage. Advance actual elapsed time once, settling timed sources and supplies, then legal arrival and events.

blockers: Current hex movement costs and End Turn day advancement are not the SRD distance/pace clock. Terrain aliases plains/grassland, town/urban and dungeon/Underdark require campaign mapping. Foraging yields, lost-route outcomes and weather forecasts require authored facts, not invented SRD quantities.
reuse_boundary: Existing accepted pieces remain accepted at their documented limits; these requirements do not mark the entire slices missing.

source_parameters.authority: SRD 5.2.1 pp.12,192; retain full page context and source exceptions

pace_table.check_effect: Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception or Survival) and Dexterity (Stealth)

source_parameters.roads: Increase maximum pace one step, Slow to Normal or Normal to Fast.
source_parameters.slow_members: Slow pace if any group member Speed is half or less of normal.
source_parameters.extended_travel: After 8 hours/day, each additional hour each character makes CON save DC 10 + hours past 8 or gains 1 Exhaustion.
source_parameters.special_movement: Miles/hour = Speed/10; Normal miles/day = miles/hour times hours traveled, typically 8. Fast miles/day times 1 1/3 rounded down; Slow times 2/3 rounded down. Flying or ignoring Difficult Terrain permits Fast regardless of terrain.
source_parameters.vehicle_source_reconciliation: p.12 permits ordinary land vehicle pace selection; p.192 says vehicles use vehicle mph without choosing pace. Retain both source bodies and resolve applicability before promotion.
campaign_aliases_unresolved: dungeon to Underdark; room travel is not automatically overland travel
source_parameters.no_inferred_outcomes: DCs do not supply foraging yield, navigation failure destination or encounter placement; author campaign facts separately.
